notes: Premium circular avatar portraits for Majarra child profiles. ALL assets are 1:1 square, 1024x1024, centered head+shoulders only, 70% face framing, safe for circular crop.
These are TRUE avatar designs, not crops from character sheets. Each prompt describes the character's face, expression, and modest attire, inspired by Majarra story universe.
Background is always solid deep-navy #0B1026 with subtle royal-blue rim light, to match app's cinematic background and make circular avatar pop.
Prompts in English (model parses visual English better). No Arabic text inside image. Luma, Nouma, Zaina, Yaseen, Salma, Addaad, Robo are original Majarra IP.
Critical canvas rule: edge-to-edge 1:1 native, no letterboxing, no duplicate side panels, no frame.
Generation command: node tools/playveo/generate.mjs --manifest majarra-avatars.manifest.json --validate (dry) then --rest
style_tail: Premium square avatar portrait, 1:1 aspect, centered head and shoulders only, close-up face filling 70 percent of frame, clean solid deep-navy background #0B1026 with subtle royal-blue rim light and soft cyan glow, soft stylized 3D animation Pixar style, highly detailed expressive eyes, warm lighting, centered composition safe for circular crop, ultra sharp, no full body, no legs, no waist below chest, no background characters, no text, no logo, no watermark, no letters, no frame, edge-to-edge full-bleed. Authentic Arab facial features, warm skin tones. CRITICAL CANVAS RULE: Render natively 1:1 as one coherent full-bleed composition, no letterboxing, no pillarboxing, no duplicate side panels, no blurred mirrored edges.
negative_prompt: full body, legs, feet, waist below shoulders, distant shot, tiny face, multiple people, crowd, background characters, text, letters, Arabic letters, watermark, logo, frame, border, blurry, low quality, photorealistic, realistic photo, scary, angry face, teeth visible, open mouth teeth, sad crying, hair visible when hijab required, uncovered hair for hijab characters, western generic, no eyeglasses glare
character_lock_note: Each asset has its own character lock inline, because they are distinct characters. Do not share.
